svg.title: The shared Starship prompt
svg.desc: Two prompts in the Gruvbox Dark palette, set in the terminal's Nerd Font. The first shows operating system and user, shell, directory, Git branch and status, Node.js version and time after a successful command. The second shows a failed command in a folder without a repository or language: the separators stay and leave thin color bands.

g.text: One prompt for Zsh, Bash and the Claude status line
Git repository with a Node.js project, last command succeeded
Folder with no repository or language, last command failed
